A1.text: Okay, so I asked AI to design my dream bathroom...

A3.text: Obviously, I have to build it for real.

A4.text: Full disclaimer: I have zero plumbing experience.

A5.text: Let's tear out the old one.

B1.text: Problem one: this floor is basically a science experiment.

B2.text: Problem two: the AI thinks marble grows on trees.

B3.text: Problem three: there is no actual plumbing in this plan.

B4.text: But you know what? We start with the sink.

C2.text: Step two: a bucket. Extremely designer.

C3.text: Step three: an umbrella. Because the AI put the faucet in the ceiling.

C4.text: And a concrete block. So it doesn't, you know... move.

D1.text: So... is it real, or is it AI? Honestly, at this point, neither.

D2.text: I'm just copying the picture. Badly.

E2.text: It's a bucket with a skirt. But the vibe? Correct.

E3.text: Next, the AI added a fish tank. Right next to the toilet.

F1.text: Why? No idea. But I already bought the fish.

F2.text: So now I'm installing an aquarium before I install a toilet.

F3.text: And apparently the flush goes inside the wall.

F4.text: I don't have a wall. I have a bucket.

G1.text: Did that stop me? Obviously not.

H2.text: The sink works. Sort of. Once.

H3.text: The toilet? We don't talk about the toilet.

H4.text: Honestly... this was way harder than it looked.

H5.text: So... how do I fix this? Comment below.
